notes: shitpaper (SHITPAPER): fixed supply of 1,000,000,000 * 1e18 minted once to the deployer (the launch factory); no owner, no admin functions, no minting after launch. A 3% fee applies only to ERC-20 transfers out of the Uniswap v4 PoolManager (buys) and is deducted from what the buyer receives; transfers to the PoolManager (sells, the pool seed) and wallet-to-wallet transfers pay nothing. Fees stay in the token contract and are distributed pro rata to eligible holders before the buyer's net amount is credited; holders claim with claim(), anyone can pay a holder out with claimFor(address). The PoolManager, the token contract, 0x...dEaD and the launch's Merkle distributor (read from factory.distributorOf(launchNumber) at transfer time) are excluded from dividends. Constructor: (address factory, address poolManager, uint64 launchNumber), stored as immutables; it calls no other contract and mints the whole supply to msg.sender. No application contracts. Pool paired with IMD at 1.25% fee, tick spacing 60; the factory seeds the pool with poolBps of the supply and forwards the remainder to remainderTo. initialPrice is provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from the economics.
